name: Pangeo Forge Recipes
section_title: Materials science, energy, and research software
yang_dicari: Pipeline code that converts datasets into cloud-optimized analysis formats.
cara_pakai: Find a relevant recipe or feed, then check the source data reference and the published metadata.
catatan: The repository states it is no longer under active development, and it is not a paper-code index.

name: MLCommons DataPerf
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: Benchmark tasks, baseline code, and dataset development evaluation.
cara_pakai: Open the challenge or the DataPerf paper; run the reference baseline and the evaluator.
catatan: Challenge-specific implementations, not paper source code for every field.

name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: Classic and new datasets with task descriptions and citations.
cara_pakai: Find the dataset in the paper, then track the implementation down through the GitHub article.
catatan: It contains data; it does not promise the implementation code for a paper.

name: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: Forecasting datasets, R/Python reader code, baselines, evaluation, and related NeurIPS papers.
cara_pakai: Open the Results or Software/GitHub tab on the official site; match the horizon and metric.
catatan: Its main strength is datasets and metadata, not every model script from the papers.

name: Nature Scientific Data
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: Data descriptors and code availability statements for custom processing code.
cara_pakai: Search a topic in the journal, then open Code availability and access the software or data.
catatan: Not all papers use custom code, and some access is restricted.

name: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB)
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: Labelled time-series datasets, scoring, a runner, baselines, and the related publication.
cara_pakai: Clone the repository, run the detector evaluation, and compare the scores against the paper.
catatan: An older release, so expect to adjust the Python environment and the benchmark metrics.

name: PyTorch Geometric (PyG)
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: GNN layers from various papers, datasets, train and eval examples, and models.
cara_pakai: Search for the method name in the docs and examples; follow the paper reference on the layer.
catatan: A framework implementation is not identical to every paper pipeline.

name: Deep Graph Library (DGL) Examples
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: Example implementations of GNN papers, including traffic forecasting, link prediction, and node classification.
cara_pakai: Find the Official DGL Examples list; open the paper link and run the relevant example.
catatan: DGL notes that some examples are compatible only with specific versions.

name: TimeEval Research Benchmark
section_title: Benchmarks, datasets, and paper implementation research
yang_dicari: An evaluation toolkit, hundreds of datasets, containerized algorithms, and PVLDB paper links.
cara_pakai: Use the TimeEval algorithms and benchmark manager; replicate the protocol from the paper.
catatan: Docker and Linux/WSL may be required; check the runtime version.
